hypotheses.representation_type: exponential decay kernel with affine argument maps and scalar/complement transforms
hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Let F(t)=exp(-t). Substitute the instance-map argument into F, then apply the scalar/complement transform: G0001 = y*F(theta*t); G0002 = (sigma**2/(2*theta))*(1 - F(2*theta*t)); G0003 = (sigma**2/(2*theta))*F(theta*Abs(s - t)); G0004 = x0*F(beta*t/2); G0005 = 1 - F(beta*t).
hypotheses.rationale: All five catalog entries are obtained from the same exponential decay kernel exp(-t) by substituting linear/absolute-value arguments and applying scalar multiplication or the complement map 1 - F(argument).
